tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/internal-http.md <<'EOF'
# Plain HTTP for internal hosts

The project's current recorded decision is that HTTPS is used everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions, so internal hosts are not permitted to communicate over plain HTTP.
EOF
cat docs/policies/internal-http.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/internal-http.md`. It says the current recorded decision is HTTPS everywhere, with no plaintext exceptions, so internal hosts may not use plain HTTP.

That decision comes from two records. An earlier one (#28) said plain HTTP was fine for internal hosts. A later one (#29) said HTTPS everywhere and replaced it. I left the retired position out of the file.

Both are trust-1 session excerpts, not entries in the decision catalogue. So the file rests on the most recent recorded statement, not on a confirmed decision record.
